content.text: This failing test isn't flaky — it's catching a real gap: the dev server serves docs via `StaticFiles` but never sets `Cache-Control: no-cache`, which is exactly the header a live-reload tool needs (fixed in `sphinx_autobuild/middleware.py`, next to the existing JS-injection middleware). Deleting the test would hide that. Fixing it is a one-line change, so let's just fix it.
